syllabus: First assessment 2021; final assessment 2028; excludes first-assessment-2029 revision
provenance: Original independently syllabus-authored practice; no copied question wording or artwork

assessment.paper1: Technology required; 90 minutes; 80 marks; short response
assessment.paper2: Technology required; 90 minutes; 80 marks; extended response

scopeReview: Integer powers and numerical logarithms; no logarithm laws, infinite geometric series, complex numbers or matrices.
Financial solver questions use end-of-period payments and independently verified recurrence balances.
Functions use numerical inverse concept, models fitted through given observations, degree sinusoidal features; no general inverse derivation or nonlinear regression.
Degree sectors, right-triangle 3D geometry, unique sine-rule triangles, perpendicular bisectors and Voronoi boundaries with the correct edge/ray restrictions.
Chi-square expected counts exceed5 and degrees of freedom exceed1; goodness-of-fit df=categories-1; t-tests pooled, unpaired, unknown equal variances, normal populations.
Analytic derivatives/integrals use integer powers; no chain/product/quotient rules, transcendental derivatives, ODEs or kinematics exam questions.
markingReview: Distinct M1 method, A1 result and R1 reasoning criteria. Every part and question mark sum is asserted; no marks for merely copying given answers. Equivalent forms and correct follow-through accepted when the changed value preserves the demand.
precisionReview: Unrounded working retained; three significant figures use decimal half-up rounding with explicit trailing zeros. Currency overrides to cents and integer counts are rounded as instructed.
